verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server that exposes web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarizer tools ready for agent tool calls. It also publishes first-party guides for Claude desktop, Dify, n8n, Open WebUI, OpenClaw and Bedrock, plus Skills for many coding agents, alongside an LLM Context endpoint built for machine consumption. The ToS thread only shows that AI use needs the separate AI Inference plan; it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicitly documented function-calling JSON schemas outside MCP (no OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths), coverage of mainstream code frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call quality.
